title: A fix for the red tint issue on the Galaxy S26 Ultra may be coming later this month
description: Last month, Samsung acknowledged reports that the Galaxy S26 Ultra display can have a red tint under certain conditions and promised a fix for it – the company blamed it on a software issue, not a hardware one. Said fix is coming by the end of the month, according to Samsung’s customer support team in Korea. One user on the Samsung Community forum posted a screenshot of a conversation with support, which claims that the fix is currently being evaluated by the verification department. title: RayNeo unveils productivity-focused iO glasses and multimedia-focused GT glasses
description: RayNeo, one of the top AR smart glasses companies out there (with 23.7% market share, based on Counterpoint data for Q1 2026), unveiled two new product lines – the iO and the GT series. The former focuses on “glanceable” ambient intelligence, the latter is all-in on multimedia (games and movies). The RayNeo iO Smart Glasses have a lightweight build for all-day wear. They weigh 33g and have an even 50:50 weight distribution between the front and the back. The frames are made of AZ91D magnesium-aluminum alloy, while the temples are made of aerospace-grade titanium. The iO uses a...

title: Epic Games thinks that Apple's new EU app store rules still violate the Digital Markets Act
description: The European Commission may be happy with Apple’s new app store rules, but Epic Games sure isn’t. The Fortnite developer and proprietor of one of the largest game stores thinks that Apple’s changes still violate the Digital Markets Act. The Irish Independent posted quotes from a European Commission spokesperson: “The Commission welcomes Apple’s changes to their business terms, which follow a close dialogue between the Commission and Apple after the Commission issued a non-compliance decision related to Apple’s steering terms as well as preliminary findings related to alternative app...

title: Poco X8 Power with 10,000mAh battery said to launch soon
description: The Poco X8 series currently comprises the X8 Pro and X8 Pro Max, with a base X8 model also rumored to be in the works. Now, a new leak claims that Poco is preparing to launch an X8 Power variant as well. According to a tipster, the Poco X8 Power could debut soon with a massive 10,000mAh battery. The tipster has also shared the phone's full specifications, suggesting that it could be a rebranded Redmi Note 17 Pro Max, which is set to launch next week. Poco X8 Pro Max The Poco X8 Power is tipped to feature a 6.83-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate and 1.5K resolution. The...

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 unboxing
description: Now that we've welcomed the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 to the office, we can say we've completed the set. And it's a very pink and purple set indeed. We've got the Galaxy Z Fold8 and Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra reviews over here if you want to check those out, but now let's have a look at the Z Flip8. The short version is this: Galaxy Z Flip8 is a Galaxy Z Flip7 with a newer chipset and a pink color. We're not sure whether Samsung thinks its flip foldable is perfect or the new market realities meant it may exceed the budget, but it has been unenthusiastic with its upgrades. So, what is...

title: Honor Turbo 5G silently unveiled
description: Following a recent listing on AliExpress, Honor Turbo 5G is now official. The official listing on Honor Eurasia confirms the previously leaked specs which include the Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chipset, a 6.79-inch AMOLED (FHD+120Hz), an 8,560 mAh battery and IP69 ingress protection. The phone ships with MagicOS 10 based on Android 16 and also features a 50MP main cam and a 5MP ultrawide lens. It is available in black, green and orange colors and starts at RUB 33,990 ($411) in Russia.

title: vivo V80 Lite with 10,000mAh battery to debut on September 3
description: The vivo V80 Lite appeared on an Indian retailer’s Instagram page earlier this week, hinting at an imminent launch. Now, the official vivo Malaysia website has confirmed the phone’s launch, albeit with a different design. vivo Malaysia has announced that the V80 Lite 5G will launch in the country on September 3. The company has also confirmed that the phone will pack a 10,000mAh battery. The company has also revealed the design of the upcoming smartphone. It will be available in black, green, and pink color options and features a flat frame and flat rear panel. The rear houses a...

title: Poco M8x arrives with the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC, a 120Hz display, and a 7,900 mAh battery
description: Poco today unveiled the Poco M8x as the newest member of its M8 series. The Poco M8x is powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC, making it India's first smartphone to have that chip at the helm. It has up to 6GB of LPDDR4X RAM and up to 128GB of UFS 2.2 storage, expandable via a microSD card. On the software side, the M8x runs Android 16-based HyperOS 3, with Poco promising four generations of Android OS upgrades and six years of security updates. The Poco M8x is built around a 6.9" HD+ 120Hz LCD, protected by Gorilla Glass 7i. It also has a centered punch-hole for the 8MP selfie...

title: OnePlus tipped to launch a new budget phone in India
description: After announcing its exit from North America and Europe, OnePlus reaffirmed its commitment to India and said it would continue launching new smartphones in the country. Following the OnePlus N6x launch last month, a new rumor now claims that the company is preparing to unveil another budget phone soon. Tipster Yogesh Brar claimed in a post on X that OnePlus is planning to launch a new budget smartphone in India. The handset is reportedly set to be a 4G-only device. OnePlus N6x According to Brar, the phone could be unveiled as early as next month and will be exclusive to India. It...

title: Infinix Hot 70 Pro's India launch timeframe announced, color options revealed
description: The Infinix Hot 70 Pro, unveiled last month, will debut in India soon. Infinix hasn't revealed the Hot 70 Pro's India launch date yet, but said it will arrive in India in the first week of September. Infinix also confirmed that the Hot 70 Pro will be sold through Flipkart in India and will come in four colors - Mirage Green, Dive Blue, Silk Glow Purple, and Thermo Orange. The Infinix Hot 70 Pro's Thermo Orange model features a back panel that changes color with temperature, while Mirage Green has a finish that "transforms under nighttime conditions." title: Here's when Nothing OS 5.0 based on Android 17 is getting unveiled
description: Ever since Google released Android 17, you may have been wondering when Nothing will release its own interpretation of the new OS. Well, we are getting closer. The company has just announced that Nothing OS 5.0, which will be based on Android 17, is "coming soon". But wait, there's more. The company says it will announce something related to the new Nothing OS 5.0 release on August 25 at 11:00 AM BST, which is 12:00 PM in Central Europe and 3:30 PM in India. There are no other details for now, but we can assume that the company will announce the Nothing OS 5.0 features...

title: Poco F9 Ultra runs Geekbench confirming its chipset and RAM amount
description: The Poco F9 Pro and Poco F9 Ultra are coming soon, it seems, with the number of leaks about them increasing in the past week. Now, the Ultra appears to have run Geekbench 7, achieving a single-core score of 2,980 and a multi-core score of 10,030. It's powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, paired in the specific prototype which ran the benchmark with 16GB of RAM, but of course we assume other memory options will be available upon launch. title: Counterpoint: European smartphone shipments drop to three year low
description: The European smartphone market experienced its lowest volume of shipments for Q2 (April – June) since 2023. A new report from Counterpoint Research estimates 35 million smartphone shipments for the period, which is a 10% drop from the values seen last year. Factors like spiraling inflation, the Iran conflict and component price hikes all contributed to the three-year low. Europe Smartphone Shipments Share by OEM, Q2 2025 vs Q2 2026 (Counterpoint Research) According to Counterpoint’s estimates, Apple and Samsung each contributed 34% of total smartphone shipments in the region. title: New Samsung Galaxy A08 certification reveals a jump in battery capacity
description: A few days ago the upcoming Samsung Galaxy A08 was spotted in the Google Play Console database. Now it's also been certified by Anatel in Brazil, ahead of its launch over there. The certification reveals that the Galaxy A08 has a battery with a rated capacity of 5,830 mAh, which will be marketed as a typical capacity of 6,000 mAh. That's a significant jump from the Galaxy A07's 5,000 mAh battery. We are of course talking about the 4G models here. Like the A07, the A08 will be powered by the MediaTek Helio G99 SoC, paired with up to 8GB of RAM. The A08 4G actually could be an A07 4G...

title: Redmi Watch 6 Active is now official with a big battery and 140 sports modes
description: The Redmi Watch 6 Active last leaked a few days ago, and today it's finally become official. It's already listed in Xiaomi's Chinese online store, and it's up for grabs for CNY 349 (approximately $51). You can get it in Gunmetal, Pink Orange, and Silver colorways. Redmi Watch 6 Active colors It sports a 1.85-inch AMOLED screen with 390x450 resolution and 1,200-nit peak brightness, a 9.9mm thick plastic case, and a 470 mAh battery. title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ and S12 Ultra prices leak
description: Samsung is unveiling the Galaxy S26 FE next week, and the company is also expected to announce the Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra very soon, perhaps on the same day or, if not, in early September. Ahead of their release, a reliable source has today revealed the pricing for the two tablets. In the US, the Galaxy Tab S12+ will start at $1,119.99 with 256GB of storage. The 512GB version will set you back $1,399.99. The 5G-capable model with 256GB of storage will be priced at $1,349.99. title: Samsung's One UI 9.5 might use AI to let you design custom widgets, leak shows
description: Google’s new Gemini Intelligence AI has a feature called Create My Widget – basically, it takes in a plain language description of what the widget should do, figures out how to do it and places the widget right on your homescreen. Now it looks like Samsung will include a similar (or the same) feature in One UI 9.5. The Samsung version is labeled “My Custom Widget” and can be seen in the screenshot below that was shared by Fahad Ali Javed. description: A leaked demo video recently surfaced online, showcasing how Apple's rumored camera-equipped AirPods could work. The leak suggested that the new AirPods could debut alongside the iPhone 18 Pro lineup next month. Despite the leaked video, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that Apple is still targeting a 2027 launch for the camera-equipped AirPods. title: Samsung is now charging up to 15% more for the chips it makes, insiders say
description: The AI boom has gobbled up manufacturing capacity on TSMC’s leading-edge fabs, so companies are turning to Samsung to make their chips – and this has given the company enough leverage to increase its prices by up to 15%, say insiders who spoke to Reuters. In July, Samsung started charging US and Chinese customers 10-15% more for its 4nm node, called SF4, than it did the month before. Companies from Taiwan are looking at 5-10% higher bills. title: The big three US carriers are offering some Pixel 11 models for free, here is what you need to know
description: The Google Pixel 11 series is now available in stores and from carriers in select regions, following a week of pre-orders. Here’s a look at what the big three US carriers have to offer. T-Mobile is offering the three non-folding models for free – or as the carrier puts it “get the Pixel 11 Pro XL on Us”. This means that it’s $1,300 off, making the base model free. You need to add a new line or trade in an old device (in any condition) and sign up for Experience Beyond 2.0 and Go5G Next.
